entries.07d6d5fcd7bf2516: Develops urban commercial buildings such as rental residences, store buildings and office buildings, and sells them to investment corporations and general corporations and others. It operates brands including the luxury rental residence “THE DOORS,” the commercial building series “A＊G” and the office series “THE EDGE.”
entries.11c53c21c31cd9a6: Business that purchases used condominiums and other properties, renovates them and sells them as regenerated homes to general customers. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥13,240 million.
entries.477b69b4928a4696: ＤＸ Real Estate Value Enhancement Business
entries.8a1d47b7cdb4117b: Purchases properties newly built by other developers in new condition and sells them with added value through coordination of lifestyle goods, interiors and similar.
entries.93fc2cc765b4b4ae: Business that develops income-generating properties, newly built condominiums for sale and built-for-sale houses, and sells them to corporate customers, general customers and others. It is involved from land procurement through product planning, design, construction and sales. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥20,226 million.
entries.972e3923a767f8ce: Purchase and Resale of New Condominiums
entries.9e58164272b1a895: Equity-method affiliate Ābanraiku Co., Ltd. purchases land in high-demand areas and builds and sells design-oriented built-for-sale houses, applying know-how developed in custom-built homes.
entries.a5a6e0fd8e97605d: Identifies the latent value of land, resolves complex rights adjustments and issues, then prepares development plans and carries out certain procedures before selling to general corporations and others.
entries.ace85f148933ebe6: Real Estate Sales Brokerage and Related Operations
entries.ae49b8a2599290f8: Holds rental real estate such as healthcare facilities, hotels, commercial facilities and office buildings, and leases it to operators and others. Principal rental real estate is located in Fukuoka, Nagoya, Sapporo and elsewhere.
entries.b707a4a23958bbda: It purchases used condominiums individually, regenerates them through planning of renovation content, and sells them to general customers. It focuses on the premium segment of higher price range.
entries.bd73f63d3ad6f7e3: It develops and sells newly built condominiums in series under the names “La Atre Residence” of Ra Atore Co., Ltd. and “Rêve” of Fansutairu Co., Ltd.
entries.be447592469c7429: It conducts businesses arising from its other operations, such as real estate sales and brokerage. This category is not a reportable segment.
entries.d159a6587eeba527: A holding company group that develops and sells new and renovated real estate, and engages in real estate leasing.
entries.f9853d748ce83242: Provides real estate sales brokerage and other services. Amounts are shown separately from reportable segments; amounts by independent business are not stated in the business description in the text.
